acceptance: e2e: load-only tuned DuckDB run → the bundle carries platform.tuning whose ddl/post_load statements equal those of the corresponding full run (or the run is refused with the decided message).
context:
Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan task P3.3 (R-3).

Added 2026-10-05 after PR #2677 (post-load seam, merge 4cfa94006b6d563946aacb68f64cb15be0c4a98b): `_execute_load_only_mode` (benchbox/core/runner/runner.py) calls load_data directly, so the per-table post-load hooks run (ClickHouse optimize_after_load, Redshift ANALYZE when auto_analyze is off, Databricks OPTIMIZE/ANALYZE, Snowflake RESUME RECLUSTER), but their time is not subtracted from the load time and no phases.post_load_maintenance phase is written. Redshift's isolated VACUUM/ANALYZE pass (configure_for_benchmark) does not run in load-only mode, so tuned Redshift tables are no longer vacuumed at load time there; a later benchmark run restores it. Parity (or refusal) should cover these too, and the CHANGELOG already notes the Redshift effect.
description:
## Problem
`--phases generate,load` goes through `_execute_load_only_mode` (`benchbox/core/runner/runner.py:528-585`). It applies a different subset of tuning from a full run (the CTAS sort runs, `apply_unified_tuning` does not), saves no metadata, and exports `platform.tuning: null` under a tuned `tuning_mode`.

## Change (per gate D-4)
- **Parity (expected):** route through the same apply → load → post-load → reconcile → metadata → ledger/receipt → export path as `_setup_fresh_database_phases`.
- **Or refusal:** an actionable error for tuned load-only runs.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- A load-only bundle never carries a tuned mode without `platform.tuning`.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
